matched_services._about: Step 2 (Matched services). The simulated AI's matches, drafts and provider replies, one block per need category. Eligibility checks (✓ ✗ ?) and the ranking are worked out in matched-services.js from the rules and weights below, so changing a rule, an opening or a client fact here changes the cards. Placeholders: {first} {age} {provider} {address} {phone} {when} {bring} {cm} {org} {org_phone}. Real public listings have "real": true. Openings, credibility numbers, ratings, and the shelter, residence and clinic listings are simulated.

ranking._about: Score = availability points + credibility + distance penalty + eligibility penalties. Highest score is #1. Cards with a ✗ go to Not a match, unless the only ✗ is a document the client is getting (an open ID need).

client_facts._about: Facts the AI pulled from the approved note, used for eligibility checks. A fact that isn't here shows as ? (ask). Other clients fall back to the age, gender and neighborhood on their record.
